node.statement: Ambient unit clause for m=1: u_1(I_{C^2})=v_fresh(1,1)=u_{S_{P_fresh}}. Since P_fresh is a t_1-projection in the extended t_1-algebra A and t_1<=e_corner_unit, lem-maincb-compressed-corner-unit-comparison gives ||u_{S_{P_fresh}}-P_fresh||<=C_corner_unit*t_1. Here P_fresh=w(I_C), so the displayed incoming estimate and c0*epsilon<=t_1 give ||u_1(I_{C^2})-I_A||<=C_corner_unit*t_1+c0*epsilon<=(C_corner_unit+1)*t_1.
